title: Giant
wikitext:
A type of creature or [[mob]] in the game similar to [[Humanoid|humanoids]], but of the very large sort (above 3 meters/yards or so) and larger than most [[Ogre]]s. This includes most [[semi-intelligent]] large humanoids and some [[intelligent]]. Most giants are [[elite]].
